title: AWS CloudOps Agent Skill Schema (agentskills.io compliant)
description: Schema for SKILL.md YAML frontmatter. Follows the agentskills.io spec with AWS-CloudOps-auditor extensions in metadata (pipeline phase, CloudOps family, verdict shape). Validates the full softaworks pattern frontmatter used by every shipped skill.

name.description: Skill identifier (lowercase, hyphens, must match directory name). Must not start with a digit.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it, including trigger keywords for routing. This is the activation trigger that agents use for skill discovery.

license.description: License name or reference to bundled license file

compatibility.description: Environment requirements (agent runtime, Python version, AWS CLI version, system packages, etc.)

author.description: Author or team responsible for the skill

keywords.description: Discovery keywords for routing (AWS service names, audit verbs, compliance frameworks)

tags.description: Top-level tags for discoverability (mirrors metadata.tags for backwards compatibility)

dependencies.description: Other skills this skill routes to or requires (e.g., aws-orchestrator for pipeline-aware skills)

metadata.description: AWS CloudOps agent extensions. Fields: domain (aws-cloudops), complexity (low|medium|high), requires_llm (bool), phase (integer 1-4 mapping to Assess|Audit|Prioritize|Remediate), supports_pipeline (bool), entry_point (bool, true only for aws-orchestrator), family (Security|Compute|Storage|Networking|FinOps|Governance|Databases|Analytics|AppIntegration|DevTools|AI/ML|Management|Migration), verdict_shape (string describing the deterministic output, e.g., 'SAFE|PUBLIC|AMBIGUOUS'), version, author, tags[], dependencies[], keywords[], when_to_use.

task_type.description: CloudOps task type: audit (assess posture), deploy (provision), troubleshoot (diagnose), optimize (reduce cost/improve perf), operate (day-2 ops), automate (workflow/pipeline).

skill_class.description: Capability = durable knowledge; Preference = temporary, retire as models improve.
